subject: POC: Network isolation & compliance evidence plan (SOC 2 / HIPAA)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Doyle <rachel.doyle@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Network isolation & compliance evidence plan (SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Hi Rachel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can line up the POC and any procurement/security gates on your side.

What we heard from the call:
- You need the POC to run in a private/isolated environment (preferred: VPC with strict egress controls).
- Compliance constraints: evidence of SOC 2 controls, and confirmation we'll be covered under a BAA for PHI flows.
- Desire to evaluate both a private VPC deployment and an air-gapped on-prem option for the most sensitive workloads.

Items we need from Aurelia to qualify the POC:
1) SOC 2 status: Do you have an existing SOC 2 report (Type II preferred)? If not, expected target for Type II?
2) BAA: point of contact to start BAA paperwork and any internal legal templates/procurement timeline.
3) Network snapshot: a simple diagram of the target environment for the POC (subnets, NAT/GW, egress patterns, proxy/load balancer). PDF or PNG is fine.
4) Expected traffic profile for the POC: concurrent requests, average sequence lengths, and whether model responses will include PHI in production.
5) Any existing vendor questionnaire (we can start filling it) or a bucket where we should upload our answers.

What Redwood will provide this week:
- A short security checklist tailored for the POC (attached).
- A preliminary network sketch showing two deployment options (private VPC vs air-gapped on-prem) for you to annotate.
- A sample mutual action plan with dates for the POC run and handoffs.

Proposed next milestones:
- Jul 6: technical kickoff (30–45m) with your infra lead to walk the sketch and carve scope.
- Jul 10: exchange of evidence (SOC/pen-test summary, BAA initiation).
- Jul 17: POC environment ready (tentative).

Attachments: redwood-poc-security-checklist.pdf (summary of what we need), poc-network-sketch-v1.png (initial topology).

If the timeline looks off, share your preferred dates and I'll adjust. Happy to keep this scoped tightly for procurement.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Rachel Doyle <rachel.doyle@aureliahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Network isolation & compliance evidence plan (SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the write-up and clear asks. A few answers from our side to help you qualify: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I report (2027) and are actively working towards Type II; target for completion is Q4 2028. We can share the Type I report and our control narrative now.
- HIPAA / BAA: Aurelia is a covered entity; our legal team requires a standard BAA. Can your legal ops receive a template?
- Network diagram: attaching a very high-level sketch of our intended POC subnet layout (file: aurelia-poc-net-snapshot.png). This is intentionally high-level — we can do a deeper runbook after the kickoff.
- On-prem air-gap: We do have a secure, isolated co-lo that could be used for an air-gapped evaluation, but procurement will need a scoping sheet (cost/ops).
- Traffic: For the initial POC, estimate ~10 concurrent sessions, avg request payload ~2KB, avg response ~1–2KB; some records may include limited PHI fields.

I have looped our security mailbox (security-team@aureliahealth.com) and will bring our infra lead (Mark Santos) into the technical kickoff if we lock a date.

Attachments: aurelia-poc-net-snapshot.png, aurelia-security-templates.zip (legal/procurement templates).

Best,
Rachel Doyle
Head of Product Operations | Aurelia Health
rachel.doyle@aureliahealth.com

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Doyle <rachel.doyle@aureliahealth.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Network isolation & compliance evidence plan (SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Thanks Rachel — helpful context. A couple of clarifications and confirmations from Redwood before the kickoff: 

- We can accept a SOC 2 Type I now for initial access; for production we'll require Type II or documented compensating controls. Please share the Type I PDF and the control narrative when convenient.
- For BAA: our legal team confirms they can start from your template. Mateo / Ben, can you take point on intake?
- For the air-gapped option: our on-prem installer supports both fully offline installs (air-gapped media + HSM integration) and a private VPC build that uses a managed NAT for controlled egress. For the POC, recommend starting with private VPC (faster) and plan a second evaluation if you want strict air-gap.
- For the POC network sketch we attached an annotated version (redwood-poc-security-checklist.pdf and poc-network-sketch-v1.png). The sketch calls out minimal required outbound endpoints (package updates/metrics) and an option where egress is disabled and a sidecar sync is used for model weights.

Ask from Aurelia before the kickoff:
- Confirm whether PHI will be redacted for the POC or if you'll allow synthetic PHI inside the test dataset.
- Provide a contact in procurement/legal to route the BAA and any purchase order details.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share SOC Type I and procurement contact by Jul 3.
2) We run the technical kickoff Jul 6 (30m) — invite Mark if available.
3) Post-kickoff, we’ll deliver a scoped M.A.P. and a list of evidence items to exchange by Jul 10.

Attachments: redwood-poc-security-checklist.pdf (checklist), poc-network-sketch-v1.png (annotated network sketch).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

From: Rachel Doyle <rachel.doyle@aureliahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Santos <mark.santos@aureliahealth.com>, security-team@aureliahealth.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Network isolation & compliance evidence plan (SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Soojín / Mateo — thanks, this is great. Confirming next steps: 

- SOC Type I and our procurement contact (kevin.liu@aureliahealth.com) will be sent to you by end of day Jul 3.
- We prefer synthetic PHI for the initial run. We will scope real-PHI testing only after the BAA is signed.
- Mark (cc'd) will join the technical kickoff. Jul 6 at 10:00am PT works for us — please send an invite.

I've attached a short answers doc to the questionnaire you started (aurelia-answers.pdf) — it's not exhaustive but should unblock the kickoff. Our procurement lead will follow up on the PO / pricing once the MAP is agreed.

See you on Jul 6 — will bring any additional folks from infra/security.

Best,
Rachel

Attachments: aurelia-answers.pdf
